stories.title: Follow live: Jordan Love leading Packers to early lead as Cowboys still scoreless
Rodgers throws two TDs to tie Peyton on all-time list, lifts Steelers to OT win
stories.summary: Aaron Rodgers tied Peyton Manning on the all-time passing touchdown list with 539 in the Steelers' overtime victory.

stories.title: Kings guard Simmons has torn Achilles tendon, will undergo surgery
stories.summary: Kings guard Ben Simmons has sustained a torn Achilles tendon and will undergo surgery, the team announced Sunday, an injury that is likely season-ending for the 30-year-old veteran who authored an impressive training camp on short notice for Sacramento.

stories.title: Rasmussen's gem puts Rays on cusp of World Series
stories.summary: Drew Rasmussen allowed one run over seven innings for his second postseason win, Tampa Bay's offense kept on constant pressure and the Rays beat the Guardians 3-1 on Sunday night to take a 3-2 lead in the ALCS.

stories.title: Williams shows no rust in return from injury for Bears: 'I just let it rip'
stories.summary: Caleb Williams completed 30 of 36 passes for 305 yards and a TD and showed no physical limitations from the injury he suffered Sept. 20.
